test_title: RRB NTPC UG 2025: शताब्दी शनिवार - Mega Live Test
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table in the same order in anti-clockwise order and all are facing inside. A, C, E and G are sitting in the middle of each side and rest four people are sitting at the corners of the table. If E is sitting in the west, then in which direction H is facing?
solution:
The diagram according to the information is as follows:

1) A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a square table in the **same order anti-clockwise** only and all are facing inside.

2) A, C, E, and G are sitting in the middle of each side, and the rest four people are sitting at the corners of the table.

3)If E is sitting in the west. This imply that A is sitting in the East and C in north and G in south direction and the remaining persons are arranged accordingly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28d9b37c832e99700b9c9563aee75148a4128b7bb80eec6371821ff32b999a57.png] 

Hence, H is facing in the North -West direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

The direction in which 'H' faces is asked in the question, not the position of 'H'. Then North-West should be the answer.
